safetyRule: Korean SVAM print numbering is NOT interchangeable with Japanese SVAM numbering after 011. Never assign a theme from same-number JP artwork. Check actual Korean print illustration or confirmed reprint artwork before classifying.
thematicClassification: deferred all 12 themes. No theme item added solely from card type/title.
imageArchive: External catalog URLs remain; no binary download, self-hosting or deployment.
